description: This file defines the structure and function prototypes for handling server<->client protocol conversations in various network protocols (FTP, IMAP, POP3, SMTP, etc.) in the curl library. It includes enum definitions, the main 'pingpong' struct, macros, and function declarations related to managing ping-pong protocol states and responses.

methods.name: Curl_pp_statemach
methods.description: Executes the ping-pong protocol state machine, handling responses and transitions until complete.

methods.name: Curl_pp_init
methods.description: Initializes the pingpong struct for a new response cycle.

methods.name: Curl_pp_state_timeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout for the current pingpong state in milliseconds.

methods.name: Curl_pp_sendf
methods.description: Sends a formatted command string to the server in a non-blocking manner.

methods.name: Curl_pp_vsendf
methods.description: Variable argument version of Curl_pp_sendf for formatted command sending.

methods.name: Curl_pp_readresp
methods.description: Reads and processes a response from the server.

methods.name: Curl_pp_flushsend
methods.description: Flushes any buffered data to send to the server.

methods.name: Curl_pp_disconnect
methods.description: Handles cleanup when disconnecting the ping-pong connection.

methods.name: Curl_pp_getsock
methods.description: Retrieves socket descriptors for the ping-pong connection.

methods.name: Curl_pp_moredata
methods.description: Checks if there is more data pending in the cache.
